CloudSaveBundle.title: CloudSaveBundle
CloudSaveBundle.description: Authenticated user's synchronized Star Chess progression snapshot containing native key-value entries and summary metrics.

label.description: Human-readable save label such as Primary Sync or Checkpoint.

schemaVersion.description: Star Chess save schema version tag (e.g. v7).

entries.description: Native map of starchess storage keys to their serialized string values.

deviceName.description: Origin device label for multi-device sync visibility.

clientSavedAtMs.description: Client millisecond timestamp when snapshot was captured.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server update timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

GameStatistic.title: GameStatistic
GameStatistic.description: Per-game aggregate statistics tracking wins, losses, draws, and total play duration in seconds for one of the 26 supported Star Chess games.

gameId.description: Identifier of one of the 26 supported games.

wins.description: Total wins recorded for this game.

losses.description: Total losses recorded for this game.

draws.description: Total draws recorded for this game.

playDurationSeconds.description: Cumulative play duration in seconds for this game.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server update timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: Public non-PII global leaderboard ranking profile aggregating total wins, losses, draws, and play duration across all 26 Star Chess games.

totalWins.description: Cumulative wins across all 26 supported games.

totalLosses.description: Cumulative losses across all 26 supported games.

totalDraws.description: Cumulative draws across all 26 supported games.

totalPlayDurationSeconds.description: Cumulative play time in seconds across all 26 supported games.

gamesPlayedCount.description: Number of distinct games played out of 26.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server update timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/cloudSaves/{saveId}.description: Per-user isolated Star Chess cloud save bundles and checkpoints.

/users/{userId}/gameStats/{gameId}.description: Per-user isolated statistics across the 26 supported Star Chess games.

/leaderboard/{userId}.description: Global non-PII leaderboard ranking authenticated players by total wins across the 26 supported games.
